headline: Dangote Refinery Raises LPG Prices to N1000/kg, Increasing Household Pressures
summary: Nigerian households and small businesses face rising cooking costs after the Dangote Refinery increased its liquefied petroleum gas gantry price to N1000 per kilogram.
why: Dangote Refinery is a major energy supplier in Africa, and changes in its fuel and gas prices directly impact domestic inflation and operating costs for small enterprises.
